input.quote: No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies. Customer pays only for Services ordered in a mutually executed Order Form, and its decision not to enter another Order Form is not a breach or shortfall.
input.rationale: The Agreement meets the preferred position: § 2.1 expressly disclaims any minimum quantity or purchase commitment, limits our payment obligation to Services actually ordered under an executed Order Form, and confirms that declining to place further orders is neither a breach nor a shortfall. § 12.3 reinforces this with Vendor's acknowledgement that we have made no minimum-volume (or exclusivity/MFC/no-hire) commitment, and § 7.1 bars Vendor from imposing any minimum-use or similar charge not identified in the Order Form. The only "shortfall" references (§§ 22.2–22.3) relate to audited underpayment for actual usage, not a take-or-pay commitment, and no volume caps on our usage appear. No redline needed.
